Name: Time Freeze In Multiplayer
Author: Alcatraz773
Description:
[size=4]This mod use Harmony to pause time by game's default code. It works just like the original version of the game.[/size]
[size=3]Also, here is a menu([url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/GenericModConfigMenu]GenericModConfigMenu[/url]) to control Pause Logic.[/size][img]https://github.com/alcmoe/FreezeTimeMultiplayer/assets/9844277/9ab2ebc4-41a8-405f-8fc8-111172b67a6e[/img]

[u] ﻿Any: any of players paused, game time paused.
﻿All: all of players paused, game time paused.[/u]
[size=4]Main player must install this mod, it's optional for client player, but I recommand client players install it, or it will cause some bugs.[/size]
[size=3]Here is a status bar(assets are copied from [url=https://github.com/MaciejMarkuszewski/StardewValleyMod]MaciejMarkuszewski'mod[/url]) shows FreezeTime status.[/size][img]https://github.com/alcmoe/FreezeTimeMultiplayer/assets/9844277/f5210e42-95c7-448d-9d8e-ce0ed598af88[/img]
[size=4]You can just click it to see status in chatbox.
Main player will check all players' statuses and broadcast status to all player.[/size]

[img]https://github.com/alcmoe/FreezeTimeMultiplayer/assets/9844277/92b077f1-d105-4de5-b81a-6665866c542d[/img] [img]https://github.com/alcmoe/FreezeTimeMultiplayer/assets/9844277/0464e1d0-d56b-42af-86e5-0d4dff7d6e52[/img] [img]https://github.com/alcmoe/FreezeTimeMultiplayer/assets/9844277/003d3641-c689-4fe6-867e-4def4a2f010a[/img][img]https://github.com/alcmoe/FreezeTimeMultiplayer/assets/9844277/fc1b2c63-f939-4b7d-bf2c-9056be65b87b[/img]
If a client mod don't have this mod,his color on status bar will be darker.
It just works like default game in single player!.

[url=https://github.com/alcmoe/SVMods/tree/master/FreezeTime]source code[/url]
